name: TSRC Corporation
summary: TSRC Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, import, transport, and sale of various synthetic rubber and related products in Taiwan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Synthetic Rubber and Non-Synthetic Rubber.
